method: dist-probe (DS4_DSPARK_VERIFY_DIST_PROBE=1) with dump-path tagging (ds4_metal_dump_path_tag b_/s_ around batched verify_suffix_tops vs sequential eval_token_raw_swa_top). Compared batch row0 vs seq at layer 40, pos 61 (cycle 2 of code_topk; identical committed input state at that position -> per-stage kernel divergence, no upstream contamination). Metrics: max_abs over the stage tensor; TV on softmax-normalized values (comparable to the final-logit TV reference).
chosen_stage_rationale: Highest weight-load cost (dominant bandwidth term: ~5 GiB selected / 72.56 GiB full layer set) AND a distinct batched kernel (routed_moe_batch vs routed_moe_one) AND self-contained (input ffn_norm + selected experts -> routed_out) AND the marquee stage for the Lead 08 thesis. The single-stage prototype = decode2_exact per-token structure with routed_moe_one (x2) replaced by one bit-exact M=2 union-load kernel sharing the expert dequant.

expert_selection.note: no router selection divergence at this position

per_stage_divergence.layout_note: per-expert pre-sum (6x4096); large point divergence amplified through down projection; per-expert layout to confirm at build

interpretation.reliable_per_token_outputs: Attention/hidden stages (KVcur 0.125, hc_attn_pre 0.086, attn_out 0.064) diverge MORE per-element than the FFN output stages (ffn_out 0.019, ffn_moe_out 0.018, ffn_shexp 0.014, router 0.023). The routed-expert OUTPUT (ffn_moe_out) is small due to summation cancellation across the 6 selected experts.
interpretation.expert_internal: gate_clamped/up_clamped/down show large point divergences (6.7-331), consistent with the IQ2XXS expert matmul (routed_moe_one vs routed_moe_batch) diverging and the down projection amplifying; per-expert tensor layout to be confirmed at build time (fidelity gate).
interpretation.sanity_vs_final_tv: Per-stage TVs (0.0003-0.004) and max_abs (0.005-0.13) at layer 40 are consistent with the known final-logit median TV ~0.0035 / max_abs median ~0.28 accumulating over 61 layers. SANITY-CHECK PASS.
interpretation.prototype_implication: Fusing the routed experts bit-exactly yields the largest verify_ms COST saving (biggest weight load) and proves the M=2 IQ2XXS fusion mechanism. Because the routed-expert OUTPUT divergence is already small (0.018), the prototype's measurable contribution is primarily the verify_ms cost saving, NOT a final-TV reduction; full-path exactness will also require fusing the attention path (larger per-output divergence) - that is the follow-up.
